title: Raycast hero
description: A dark, centred hero over a big crimson artwork slot: a 56px semibold two-line title, a white lead, on desktop the light download button with two mono grey lines under it, and a small pill at the bottom edge whose border highlight spins. The title and lead rise in on load, the lead a beat later.
notes: leaves room at the top for the fixed raycast header (heading starts ~256px down on phones, ~352px on desktop)
the artwork slot is a crimson wash when empty; a real image or video fills it (cover)
load animation is CSS only; the pill border spin needs @property and falls back to a plain ring
